description: This file defines the GrainAddressCacheUpdate class, which represents a directive to update an invalid cached GrainAddress with a valid one within the Orleans framework. It contains properties and methods to handle grain address validation and updating.

classes.name: GrainAddressCacheUpdate
classes.description: Sealed class representing an update directive for invalid grain address cache entries, including properties for valid and invalid addresses and related identifiers.

methods.name: GrainAddressCacheUpdate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a cache update with invalid and optionally valid GrainAddress.

methods.name: GrainId
methods.description: Gets the grain ID associated with this cache update.

methods.name: InvalidActivationId
methods.description: Gets the activation ID of the invalid grain address.

methods.name: InvalidSiloAddress
methods.description: Gets the silo address associated with the invalid address.

methods.name: ValidGrainAddress
methods.description: Returns the valid grain address if available, constructed from stored components.

methods.name: InvalidGrainAddress
methods.description: Returns the invalid grain address as reconstructed from stored components.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Override that provides a string representation of the cache update state.

methods.name: ToFullString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation including membership version.
